inputContract.coordinates: One measured module authoring frame: +X forward, +Y lateral, +Z body up
inputContract.lengthScale: Explicit measured target units per source model unit; never infer meters
inputContract.uniquePositions: Combined body and attachment, after pose and source morphology
inputContract.seams: slave vertex, original body-edge endpoints, interpolation; donors must be masters
inputContract.guide: Source-derived center/depth and radius samples per vertex; caller supplies actual module guide
inputContract.versioning: Topology ID/revision, source lineage, UV aliases, donors and support-point membership versioned together

outputContract.positions: Same combined topology with exact seam interpolation and fixed exterior
adapterResponsibilities: body opening and fitted seam binding
native morph or runtime deformation bridge

adoption.wolverine: Existing native solver is authoritative; hub consumer pending full runtime parity
adoption.witcher3: Bare body source and appearance override available; calibrated collar fit/runtime not implemented
adoption.futureGames: Implement the input/output contract in a spoke; shared numerical changes return here
